subject: CFA without crossloadings vs ESEM with crossloadings

messages.author: 9b856041872c3571
messages.subject: CFA without crossloadings vs ESEM with crossloadings
parts:
Hi all, 

This is the third paper I'm going to try to use Lavaan for and hope I don't have to end up again using Mplus ;) ... but I heard ESEM capabilities are not yet developed. Maybe you know ways around this to help me.

Essentially, I want to run a 2-factor CFA without cross loadings (model1), then run a 2-factor ESEM with data-driven cross-loadings (model2), and compare these models. Is there any way to do this in Lavaan? Would it be an option to instead run a 2-factor EFA, investigate the cross loadings, and specify model2 with said cross loadings? 

Thanks for your input
  Eiko

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: CFA without crossloadings vs ESEM with crossloadings
parts:
Hi Eiko,

If you're just doing a CFA, then ESEM (which I'm pretty sure isn't a part of lavaan yet) doesn't really apply. It sounds like your comparing CFA and EFA. If you want to fit an EFA with lavaan (to make a comparison between CFA and EFA ) take a look at the efaUnrotate function (and then the oblqRotate function) in semTools.

Alex
